en.askTitle: Describe your Mac and your videos to find an offline narrator, with voice rights checked
en.runTitle: Free offline narration on a Mac: five text-to-speech tools, 25 recordings, one pick

fields.label: Computer, operating system and memory
fields.value: An Apple-silicon Mac with 16 GB RAM, shared with other work

fields.label: Private use or public publishing
fields.placeholder: e.g. published on YouTube, so commercial use matters

en.template: Help me choose an offline narrator for {machine}, {language}, {length} and {use}. Compare setup effort, voice-specific rights and what I should listen for. Use this English test only where relevant. Ask before installing packages, downloading models, running speech tools or uploading any text or audio.

phases.title: Check each tool’s official pages and licences, then install the small offline voice engines
phases.note: Piper, Kokoro, eSpeak NG, Flite and the Mac’s built-in voice
phases.judgment: It would not call the Piper voice cleanly free to use. The voice’s own card links a research-only dataset licence that conflicts with the repository’s general MIT label, so the voice’s rights are marked unclear.

phases.title: Have each tool read five test scripts aloud under a memory cap, then transcribe and score the audio locally
phases.note: Nothing was sent online while speaking or transcribing

phases.title: Recompute the error rates a second time, write the report and check it on desktop and phone
phases.judgment: All 50 error-rate figures were recomputed a second time. The report also says nobody has listened to the audio, so how natural or emotional the voices sound is not judged.

workers: Checked the official pages for each offline speech tool: versions, licences for both the software and the voice, how to install it on a Mac, and which languages it covers

zh.askTitle: 说说你的 Mac 和视频情况，找到一款离线配音方案，并核对好音色权利
zh.runTitle: Mac 上的免费离线配音：五款文字转语音工具、25 段录音、一个推荐

fields.label: 电脑、操作系统和内存
fields.value: 苹果芯片的 Mac，16 GB 内存，还要和其他工作共用

fields.label: 私人使用或公开发布
fields.placeholder: 例如：发布到 YouTube，所以商用权利很重要

zh.template: 请帮我为 {machine}、{language}、{length} 以及 {use} 选择离线配音方案。比较安装难度、具体音色权利和需要试听的重点。只在相关时参考这份英语测试。安装软件、下载模型、运行语音工具或上传任何文本和音频前，请先问我。

phases.title: 核对各工具的官方页面和许可，再装好小型离线语音引擎
phases.note: Piper、Kokoro、eSpeak NG、Flite 和 Mac 自带语音
phases.judgment: 它没有把 Piper 的这个音色直接说成可放心使用：音色自己的说明页链接着一份只限研究的数据集许可，与代码库笼统标注的 MIT 相冲突，所以把音色权利标为不明确。

phases.title: 让每款工具在内存上限内朗读五段测试文稿，再在本机转写并打分
phases.note: 朗读和转写期间，没有任何内容发到网上

phases.title: 再重算一遍错误率，写出报告，并检查电脑和手机上的显示
phases.judgment: 50 个错误率数字都被重新算了一遍；报告也写明没有人听过这些录音，所以声音是否自然、有没有情绪，没有评价。

workers: 查了每款离线语音工具的官方页面：版本、软件和音色各自的许可、在 Mac 上怎么安装，以及支持哪些语言
